QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` returns an empty vector. It also returns empty when `vocab_` is null... `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) passes the empty result through. It returns empty when no tokenizer is wired, with no log."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a failed tokenization yields an empty vector and that the backend wrapper also returns empty when no tokenizer is wired, so the two cases are indistinguishable.
